#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    long long x1 = min(n, m);
    long long x2 = max(n, m);
    long long answer;

    switch ((int)x1) {
        case 1: {
            static const int rem[6] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1};
            answer = x1 * x2 - rem[x2 % 6];
            break;
        }
        case 2:
            if (x2 == 2) {
                answer = 0;
            } else if (x2 == 3 || x2 == 7) {
                answer = x1 * x2 - 2;
            } else {
                answer = x1 * x2;
            }
            break;
        default:
            answer = x1 * x2;
            if (answer % 2 != 0) {
                answer--;
            }
    }

    cout << answer << '\n';
    return 0;
}
